name: progress-pane
description: A Progress pane on the right: the steps of the current task, and the uncommitted git changes under them.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Off: the plugin registers nothing (no progress tool, no advice in the system prompt, no pane or band).

view.title: View
view.description: pane: a docked pane on the right; line: one row above the prompt, no width taken. /progress opens the pane either way.

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: Width the docked pane asks for. A width you drag it to wins.

showDiff.title: Show uncommitted changes
showDiff.description: List the uncommitted files (+added -removed against HEAD) under the steps in the pane.

wakeOnChange.title: Wake the model on a change
wakeOnChange.description: After you change a step, start a turn of its own so the model reads the change at once. Off: the model reads it with its next tool result or your next message.
